title: Oxygen-tuned aluminum-based halide solid electrolytes enabling low-voltage anode compatibility in all-solid-state batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02411K, Paper
Wonju Kim, Sangwook Han, Sunyoung Lee, Jaekyun Yoo, Chanwoong Park, Seungju Yu, Daero Won, Eungyeong Lee, Kun-hee Ko, Joohyeon Noh, Geunji Choi, Mireu Kim, Kisuk Kang
Oxygen-tuned aluminum-based halide solid electrolytes balance reduction stability and ion conductivity, enabling stable cycling with 0.3 V-class alloy anodes and paving the way for high-energy-density all-solid-state batteries.
